problem: decentralized control under dynamic topology failure when a legal current graph snapshot may be insufficient to identify transition context
deployment: one decentralized policy; no selector, fallback, ensemble, teacher or online failure label

forbidden: changes to reward, environment, sampler or evaluation tapes

closed_legacy_families: adaptive exposure feedback: DRTP and EGTR
nominal/failure gradient surgery: TCR and TGTR

allowed_actor_history: previous legal graph node and edge features
candidate_boundary.novelty_requirement: A later candidate must encode a local topology-transition residual and must be compared against both capacity-matched snapshot SG-MAPPO and a capacity-matched generic GNN+GRU control. A generic GNN plus GRU alone is not a contribution.

p1_precommitment.question: Does a short history of legal actor tensors carry repeatable information about a predeclared topology-transition target beyond the current legal snapshot?
p1_precommitment.data: fresh scripted, policy-neutral training-only trajectories in two disjoint state cohorts
forbidden: formal, independent or held-out evaluation tapes
p1_precommitment.pass_authorizes_only: a separate exact-formula and implementation audit; not PPO training
